summary: Petition under Section 66 of the Electricity Act, 2003, read with Regulation 17(3) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Power Market) Regulations, 2021, seeking approval of the Hon’ble CERC for proposed candidates for appointment as Independent Director on the Board of Hindustan Power Exchange Ltd. (HPX). The Petitioner, Hindustan Power Exchange Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “HPX”) has filed the present petition under Section 66 of the _Electricity Act, 2003_ (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”), and Regulation 17(3) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission _(Power Market) Regulations, 2021_ (hereinafter referred to as “PMR 2021”), seeking approval of the Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 1 of 11 Commission to appoint an Independent Director on the Board of HPX. The Board of HPX has recommended two (02) names, Mr. Deepak Amitabh and Mr. Ashok Kumar Rajput (hereinafter collectively referred to as “the candidates”), for consideration by the Commission for appointment on the Board of HPX as an Independent Director. HPX has filed a brief profile of the candidates, a statement declaring that the candidates satisfy the criteria laid down in Section 149(6) of the _Companies Act, 2013_ , and details as per “Form MBP-1”, “Form DIR-2”, and “Form DIR-8” of the _Companies Act, 2013_ , in terms of the Regulations 17(4) of PMR 2021. The Petitioner has filed the present petition with the following prayers: _1. Approve the proposed candidate (s) for appointment as Independent Director on the Board of the Petitioner;_ _2. Pass such other order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case._ 2. Regulation 17 of the PMR 2021 states provisions related to the Governance structure - _(3) A minimum of two names shall be submitted by the Board of the Power Exchange to the Commission for approval for each vacancy of_ Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 2 of 11 - _(12) The Power Exchanges which have been granted registration by the Commission prior to the date of coming into force of these regulations, shall within a period not exceeding one year from the date of coming into force of these regulations, align the governance structure as specified in this Regulation.”_ Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 3 of 11 Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 4 of 11 - _(i) holds or has held the position of a key managerial personnel or is or has been employee of the company or its holding, subsidiary or associate company in any of the three financial years immediately preceding the financial year in which he is proposed to be appointed;_ Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 5 of 11 7. The Petitioner has submitted that it has the following Directors on its Board as on the date of filing (14.04.2026) of the petition. 8. The Petitioner has submitted that prior to the appointment of Mr. Sunil Rathi on 18.03.2026, the Petitioner was required to have three (03) Independent Directors on its Board, Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 6 of 11 10. The Petitioner has submitted that the Board of HPX, in its meeting dated 18.03.2026, approved two (02) names for one (01) vacancy of an Independent Director – Mr. Deepak Amitabh (DIN: 01061535) and Mr. Ashok Kumar Rajput (DIN: 11778371). The detailed profiles of the candidates are submitted with the petition. Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 7 of 11 13. As per Regulation 17(3) of the PMR 2021, the Board of a Power Exchange is required to submit at least two (02) names to the Commission for approval for each vacancy of an Independent Director. Accordingly, the Board of HPX has approved two (02) names, viz. Mr. Deepak Amitabh and Mr. Ashok Kumar Rajput. In compliance with the requirements as provided under Regulation 17(1), 17(2), and 17(3) of the PMR 2021, the Petitioner is seeking the Commission’s approval for the appointment of one (01) Independent Director on its Board from the aforementioned names. A brief profile of the candidates proposed for appointment is submitted by the Petitioner, which is as under: Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 8 of 11 Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 9 of 11 14. The Petitioner in its petition has submitted that the candidates satisfy the criteria as required under Regulation 17(4) of the PMR, 2021. The Petitioner further confirmed that both the proposed candidates do not have any interest in the Company or in the promoters of the Company. Further, it is submitted that the proposed candidates also satisfy the criteria laid down in Section 149(6) of the _Companies Act, 2013_ . Order in Petition No. 231/RC/2026 10 of 11
